source: Existing anonymization README descriptions, diagnostic only; never passed into inference

families.M1_v5: S1-derived public-reference rank/copula correction plus later local rare adjustments; mixed pipeline, not the simple copy generator
families.S1: Preliminary v5 DP synthesis transferred to main cohort; not one of the seven simple shadow families
families.R3: Postprocessed R2 synthesis, Cox coefficient correction
families.R5: Sequential conditional CART synthesis; not in the seven-class router vocabulary
families.R7: R6-based majority/rare copula and aggregate event assignment
families.R9: Copula-derived synthesis plus aggregate distribution/correlation/Cox constraints

interpretation: Hard router labels on these compound real releases are not a valid exact 7-class accuracy test. In particular R1 is known copula-derived although T88 often calls it independent.
